title.script_alignment: A DMV queue and shrinking bank balance initiate the 50% split at age 23. The later layoff turns a separate cash reserve into a choice of a lower-paid four-day week. The closing gas-pump callback does not match the actual DMV opening. The stored ending is complete; audio timing is unverified.
